Subject: BlueHarbor go-live orchestration & MAP - draft and next steps

Hi Olivia / Jared —

Great to speak earlier. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short implementation checklist so we can align on milestones, owners, and dates. High-level proposal:

- Kickoff: week of Mar 29 (technical kickoff + requirements deep dive)
- Integration & validation: 3 sprints (2 weeks each) for connectors, prompts, and security review
- Pilot go-live (limited users): May 17
- Full go-live: Jun 7

Please review the attached MAP (BlueHarbor_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key asks for you:
1) Confirm the proposed go-live windows above or suggest alternatives
2) Identify internal owners for each milestone (integration, security signoff, procurement)
3) Flag any compliance evidence you need added to the checklist

I'll loop in Marissa (Customer Success) and Neha (Solutions) to help translate commitments into an onboarding timeline and to own the implementation once we hand off from Sales.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia / Jared —

Thanks for the loop. I've taken the draft MAP and converted it into an implementation timeline with named owners and suggested dates (attached). Summary below; full timeline in the attachment (BlueHarbor_MAP_v1.xlsx):

Milestone 1 — Technical kickoff
- Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood CSM) + Jared Singh (BlueHarbor integration lead)
- Date: 2027-03-30 10:00 PT
- Deliverables: kickoff notes, success metrics, stakeholder list

Milestone 2 — Auth & Network (firewall, IP allowlist, token strategy)
- Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood SE) + BlueHarbor infra
- Target completion: 2027-04-12

Milestone 3 — Connector development & test prompts
- Owner: Neha Kapoor + BlueHarbor devs
- Target completion: 2027-04-26

Milestone 4 — Security/compliance evidence handoff (SOC2, data flow diagram)
- Owner: Marissa Cole (coord), Olivia Barnes (BlueHarbor security)
- Target completion: 2027-05-03

Milestone 5 — Pilot validation & success review (limited user cohort)
- Owner: Marissa + Jared
- Target completion: 2027-05-17 (pilot go-live)

Milestone 6 — Production ramp & full go-live
- Owner: Marissa + BlueHarbor PM
- Target completion: 2027-06-07 (full go-live)

Action items for the kickoff:
- Olivia: finalize attendee list and network contacts
- Jared: share API specs and dev sandbox creds before kickoff
- Procurement: confirm whether the pilot needs an amendment (cc: procurement)

I've attached an "implementation_checklist.pdf" with the onboarding runbook and a one-page pilot acceptance criteria doc. If that looks good, we'll convert the MAP to our onboarding Jira board and schedule weekly 30-minute standups starting the week of Apr 5.

Marissa Cole
